nullable_fields: all immediate_impulse_* fields for NO_SIGNAL or PROVIDER_ERROR
identity_rule: prediction_id = PRD_<sha256(episode_id, provider, model, information_arm, pack_id, pack_fingerprint, forecast_cutoff_ts, prediction_target_type, prediction_target_id, contract_version)[:20]>. One authoritative Prediction is episode x provider x information_arm x frozen model configuration x cutoff.

target_rule.market_session: prohibited as a primary v2.1 target

information_arms.BASELINE: approved baseline forecast information only; pack_id=BASELINE_NO_PACK and pack_fingerprint is null
information_arms.FULL_CONTEXT: the same baseline information plus the approved shared request-driven Market-State Pack; pack_id and pack_fingerprint are required

immediate_impulse_rule.semantic_target: The first persistent and meaningful USD/JPY direction expected to become established shortly after release.
immediate_impulse_rule.separate_from_t5: Immediate Impulse is not the strict sign of the first tick and is not interchangeable with the T+5 Early Reaction field.

early_reaction_5m_rule: early_reaction_5m_direction is the explicit EARLY_REACTION_5M forecast field for Contract v1.1. It must equal the 5-minute path direction and must not be described as the strict first move.
no_signal_rule: NO_SIGNAL is valid when no_signal_flag=true, status=NO_SIGNAL, no_signal_reason is non-empty, immediate_impulse_* fields are null, early_reaction_5m_direction=UNCERTAIN, and reversal fields are null. It is not a provider failure. PROVIDER_ERROR requires no_signal_flag=false and a non-empty error_message.
